result:
The voice-agent directives now live only in the Servex remote MCP, and I restarted Servex so they are live. I didn't check whether a voice call was open before restarting. I didn't run `node Server/smoke.mjs`; `merge.mjs` ran its own smoke test when it merged.

- **`Servex/ext/remote/RemoteMCP.js`:** `initialize` now returns `instructions`, and `ask_mastermind`'s description is widened to match. It covers firing the tool first, summarizing instead of reading back, one question at a time, relaying open items, and minion results arriving on the next ask.
- **`.claude/skills/voice-mastermind/SKILL.md`:** it gets only the mastermind-side rule: answer inside the one-minute window with an ack and routing, and carry minion results to the next ask. No voice-agent directives are there.
- **`RemoteMCP.test.mjs`:** it now checks the directives, and it passes (7 calls).

The tunnel, token and reply-file code are untouched, and no tunnel address is written anywhere.

The first merge went through with a failing test (a bad import in the new check). A second commit fixed it and merged, so `michael/dev` has both.
